store_fix.semantic_equality: Equality is at the declared encoded-measurement protocol, not byte equality of unused RGB/semantic metadata or sub-millimetre raw ranges. Typed identities retain the distinctions actually queried: invalid/background/unidentified/positive physical ID.
store_fix.counterexample_fixed: Previously ingest(t,A), query through t, ingest(t,B) replaced the stored measurement while processed=t prevented replay of B; cached mosaic/calibration represented A and direct projection represented B. Conflicting B now fails, while identical A is idempotent.
store_fix.pixel_counterexample_fixed: Without a bound, row-major uint32 offsets and exclusive RLE ends wrap when rows*cols > UINT32_MAX, aliasing physical source pixels. The entry check now rejects the unrepresentable frame.

terminal_duplicate_trace.fact: Normal output calls extractOutputData, copies InputData into the output, then ingests that same FrameData.

finishMapping is locked; it clears map active flags and sets Track::is_active=false, obtains the same const buffer latest, calls terminal extractOutputData, then ingests latest. None of these lines edits latest measurements.
extractOutputData reads latest stamp/pose, updates map products and submits moved/copied Track values; frame input is passed as const and is not rewritten.
FrameData holds const InputData. Identity/cluster images are mutable members in the type, so downstream implementations were also checked.
Worker request keeps Track and buffer copies; extractor receives them and source marking edits extracted attributes only.
Dynamic extraction reads clusters/vertices; static extraction reads range/instance/pose and integrates into a private output map. No source frame measurement mutation found.
Although setFrameData accepts a mutable FrameData pointer, it only retains the pointer; computeLabel reads object_image and writes a local VoxelMeasurement.
Buffer stores/returns shared frame objects. It does not rewrite measurement pixels.

terminal_conclusion: For the current extraction/integration implementations, normal and terminal ingest of an already emitted latest frame produce equal endpoint/range/pose/sensor records. If latest was never emitted because of output spacing, terminal ingest is a new timestamp insertion. No new revision is necessary; native body/comments were not edited.

numerical_model.derivation: For beta(a,b), the retaining sequence log likelihood is log B_alpha(a+K,b+N-K)-log B_alpha(a,b); exiting is log B_upper(K+1,N-K+1)-log(1-alpha). The common binomial coefficient cancels. Optional local/population references mix likelihoods in probability, implemented with log-sum-exp.
numerical_model.production_domain: Registry completed N<=1500; precision floor gives a+b<=1502, posterior sum<=3002, alpha=.5. Static candidate pool <=1024, reference Beta(1,1), normal alpha=.2; alpha=1 is disabled upstream. Configurable alpha in (0,1) can create a true underflowed tail.
numerical_model.necessity: Normal protocol tail probabilities lie within Linux extended-long-double representation; a custom Stirling/logGamma library was unnecessary and removed. Extreme configurable alpha can underflow even at N=1024 (e.g. alpha=1e-6 gives alpha^1025), so the minimal log continued-fraction tail preserves the same integral. No numeric experiments were run.
numerical_model.stable_cases: Empty evidence gives zero log odds after parameter checks. alpha=0 uses exact point-mass limit. Mixture treats signed infinities before subtraction. Completed total checks actual n+max(U-k,0) overflow. CF convergence/numeric invalidity are explicit errors.
numerical_model.working_assumptions: Conditional Bernoulli source-group model and ignorable missingness are explicit README assumptions, not empirical claims established by this audit. Fixed 3-hit/1500/99 protocols are not assigned invented statistical confidence.

normal_runtime_defects_interpretation: After the store fixes, this static audit identified no additional confirmed normal-protocol runtime defect in these 7 files. This is a bounded self-audit conclusion, not a build/test result or independent acceptance.

remaining_limits.detail: Free-space incidence uses abs(normal dot view) and allows no-normal samples; it is a two-sided spatial evidence protocol. No claim of front-facing-only evidence or statistical orientation reliability was proved.

Pending candidate calibration queue can grow with frames until direct support authorizes it. It is necessary sufficient state for delayed authorization; this implementation does not impose a constant-in-time queue bound. PhysicalEvidenceStore also deliberately retains the current session.

Loader validates finite geometry, counts, clocks, ownership and budgets but does not recompute every stored cell-to-geometry relation. No valid-writer counterexample was found; adversarial malformed-checkpoint completeness is not certified.

Incremental processing requires that no previously unseen earlier timestamp be inserted behind an already-consumed watermark without an explicit replay/reset. Timestamp immutability fixes replacement, not arbitrary late first-arrival insertion; full producer chronological-order proof is outside these 7 files.
Raw temporary source packing assumes 64-bit size_t and fewer than 2^32 frames per query. The target is WSL/Linux64; arbitrary 32-bit builds or >2^32-frame sessions were not certified.
